title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: custom engine agents for GCC users
summary: The briefing accurately reports the roadmap's GCC launch and distinguishes it from the gaps in Learn's availability documentation. Its licensing statements, build-route limitations and block control are supported, including the warning that the governance Graph API is unavailable in GCC.

claims.claim: The roadmap states that GCC-M users will be able to use custom engine agents.
claims.quote: Users in GCC-M will be able to use custom engine agents.

claims.claim: Learn does not yet document a GCC-specific version confirming this custom engine agent release.

claims.quote: As a result, these third-party applications and services aren't covered by the Copilot Studio US Government compliance and data protection commitments.

Block a Copilot package to prevent its usage.

claims.claim: Blocking agents created using SharePoint or Microsoft Foundry affects only their availability in Microsoft Copilot Chat.
claims.quote: However, blocking an agent that you created by using SharePoint or Microsoft Foundry only impacts its availability in Microsoft Copilot Chat.
